harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), built a local RPM repository from packages downloaded to local storage, served it over HTTP from the node's own IP, blackholed the real AlmaLinux mirror/repo hostnames to simulate remote-repo unreachability, and successfully installed the `tree` package from the local repo only. Then executed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot ID, repo data checksums, HTTP 200 from local repo), rebooted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed the boot ID changed, verified repo data/config survived, restarted the local HTTP server (an ephemeral process, not a persistent unit), reconfirmed the local-repo install path still worked post-reboot while remotes were still blackholed, and finally restored normal networking.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (AlmaLinux 9.6) and existing yum repo configuration
Installed createrepo_c while remote repos were still reachable
Downloaded tree + dependency RPMs into /srv/localrepo via dnf download --resolve --alldeps
Built repo metadata with createrepo_c
Served /srv/localrepo via python3 -m http.server 8080 bound to NODE_IP
Added /etc/yum.repos.d/localrepo.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP:8080/
Blackholed mirrors.almalinux.org, repo.almalinux.org, vault.almalinux.org via /etc/hosts (backed up original first) and verified they became unreachable while local repo stayed reachable
Installed tree from localrepo only (baseos/appstream/extras disabled) while remotes were unreachable; verified via rpm -q and running the binary
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, local HTTP server liveness/200 response, installed package state, repo file checksum
Restarted node1 with systemctl reboot via a backgrounded/disowned wrapper so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again and confirmed boot_id changed
Verified installed package, repo files, and checksums survived the reboot unchanged
Restarted the local HTTP server process and confirmed it served 200 again while remote mirrors remained blackholed
Re-ran dnf against localrepo post-reboot confirming resolution/install path still functions
Restored /etc/hosts from backup and confirmed remote mirror reachability returned to normal

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: createrepo_c installed, tree RPMs downloaded to /srv/localrepo, repo metadata generated, HTTP server bound to NODE_IP returns 200 for repomd.xml, and localrepo.repo added/listed in dnf repolist.

evidence.requirement: Usual remote repositories are unreachable during the install
evidence.summary: After blackholing mirrors.almalinux.org/repo.almalinux.org/vault.almalinux.org via /etc/hosts, curl to the mirrorlist times out (exit 28) while the local repo still returns HTTP 200.

evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repo while remotes are unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install tree succeeds using only the localrepo (baseos/appstream/extras disabled), and rpm -q / tree --version confirm the package is installed and functional.
Captured boot_id 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc, uptime, local HTTP server PID alive, repo HTTP 200, installed tree package, and repo file checksum.
systemctl reboot launched via a backgrounded, disowned 2-second-delay wrapper so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' before the node dropped.

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Connection reset occurred mid-reboot, then exec became available again and boot_id read 0a9eee6e-e6cb-483c-9f5f-6ff2c461174b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required data and service
evidence.summary: After reboot, tree remained installed, /srv/localrepo files and the tree RPM checksum were unchanged, and after restarting the ephemeral HTTP server process it again returned HTTP 200 for the repo while remote mirrors remained deliberately unreachable (confirming the earlier install truly depended on the local repo); dnf against localrepo resolved cleanly post-reboot.

evidence.requirement: Cluster left in a clean, reversible state
evidence.summary: Restored /etc/hosts from backup and confirmed mirrors.almalinux.org is reachable again (HTTP 200), removing the temporary network blackhole used only for the demonstration.
